retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic low-angle illustration of a semi-truck trailer featuring bold script typography and a secondary road-sign graphic element.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact, low-angle view of a semi-truck trailer moving at speed, characterized by a large-scale script logo across the side panels and a yellow triangular road sign in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The truck trailer dominates the frame from a dramatic worm's-eye perspective.
The primary script typography is integrated into the trailer's surface texture.
A secondary graphic sign acts as a visual counterweight in the top right corner.
Motion is suggested through water splashes and blurred wheels at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the trailer
Vertical chrome exhaust pipe on the far left
Yellow triangular road sign with rounded corners
High-contrast lighting on the trailer's metallic surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The trailer occupies 80% of the frame, angled from the bottom left toward the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white script lettering centered on the trailer side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal movement from bottom-left wheels up toward the top-right road sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the blue sky in the upper right and the dark road surface at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and navy blue on the trailer panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary script and stars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the road sign graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with deep shadows and bright highlights to simulate polished metal.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders forming decorative loops
Letters are interconnected with fluid transitions
A heavy black drop shadow creates depth against the trailer
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'A' features a long, sweeping tail that underlines subsequent letters
The final 'A' mirrors the first with a decorative terminal flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A dominant, expressive script paired with a functional, utilitarian sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Yellow triangular caution sign with rounded corners
Chrome exhaust stack with perforation detail

avoid: Modernist sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, southern-rock aesthetic of the original lettering.
Appropriate for the utilitarian text inside the road sign.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a semi-truck trailer from a low-angle perspective. The trailer should have red and blue panels with white stars. Include a chrome exhaust pipe on the left and water splashes at the wheels. Leave the center of the trailer clear for text and place a blank yellow triangular road sign in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold white script logo with a black drop shadow across the trailer side, following the perspective. Add condensed black sans-serif text inside the yellow sign.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective low-angle and dramatic?
Does the script have decorative swashes and a drop shadow?
Is the yellow sign present in the top right corner?
Are the colors saturated with high-contrast highlights?

mustRedesign: Exact star patterns that mimic protected flags
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text follows the 3D plane of the trailer.
Check that the chrome elements have realistic reflections.
Verify the yellow sign is distinct from the background sky.
Confirm the script swashes do not obscure legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle [Subject: Vehicle/Object] + [Style: Airbrushed Americana] + [Typography: Bold Perspective Script] + [Graphic: Utilitarian Signage Overlay]
